data.title: 双叶理央 · 深夜卧室休息
data.description: 成年理央独自在凌乱的床上休息，床单盖住身体，松开的马尾散在枕边，眼镜放在一旁。她眼中仍有泪光，暖色台灯照着安静的房间。
data.action: 仰卧休息，床单盖住身体，眼镜放在枕旁
data.promptProse: Lying quietly on her back across her rumpled bed at night with her glasses resting beside the pillow, Rio Futaba stays unclothed beneath a pure white linen sheet draped loosely below her bare shoulders and collarbone. Her loosened hair spreads across the pillow in the gentle glow of a warm bedside desk lamp.
data.nsfwProse: She rests unclothed beneath a pure white linen bedsheet draped loosely across her torso, slipping low to reveal bare shoulders, collarbone, and bare feet.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her back across rumpled bedding with her glasses set beside the pillow and her hair fanned loose, she rests nude beneath a white linen sheet slipping across her bare collarbone with glistening eyes. A quiet warm desk lamp softens the dark bedroom.
